scope: Independent review of the mapped existing three-peer JUnit workloads and the recorded pilots under the current I/O IOException fault model. This does not exclude other workloads, a state-corruption fault model, or a concurrent mutation that has not been observed.

cases.target_identity_required: The reconnecting zk1 peer after restart, epoch 1, and that exact processConnectRequest occurrence; the other peer's update is a distinct client operation.
source_facts: ZooKeeperServer.java:1387-1445 deserializes ConnectRequest, catches only the optional readBool IOException before the selected zxid comparison, and leaves readOnly false on that catch. The catch changes neither comparison operand.

WatchEventWhenAutoResetTest.java:128-137 has client zk1 create a znode, stops peer 1, client zk2 setData on another peer, then restarts peer 1 and awaits client zk1 reconnect. The update and reconnect use different client objects.

The prior healthy witness has a same-thread readBool door at event 289 and exact guard at event 290 on zk1 epoch 1; the prior directed readBool fault retained its own guard but produced no selected throw.

The earlier connect-read exception aborts that processConnectRequest occurrence. Startup recovery/sync exceptions before startServing do not establish a same-restart serving target; the prior source gap documents those paths.

cases.target_identity_required: The same restarting follower QuorumPeer object, logical node and lifecycle epoch, plus its FOLLOWERINFO/LEADERINFO packet pair and resumed FOLLOWING attempt; a later target on another peer or attempt is insufficient.
source_facts: QuorumRestartTest.java:54-74 restarts three peers sequentially and waits for quorum connection; it does not deliberately raise acceptedEpoch or make an application write.

Learner.java:489-536 sends FOLLOWERINFO with self.getAcceptedEpoch and protocol version 0x10000, receives LEADERINFO, and checks newEpoch against acceptedEpoch before returning to Follower.followLeader.

LearnerHandler.java:484-492 decodes that protocol version; lines 524-540 obtain the proposed epoch and send LEADERINFO for version >=0x10000. Leader.java:1419-1442 raises epoch above the reported accepted epoch while forming a new epoch.

If the received LEADERINFO epoch is below the follower's acceptedEpoch, Learner.registerWithLeader throws at lines 520-525 before the selected Follower.followLeader comparison at Follower.java:99-104. A packet IOException before return likewise aborts this attempt; a later retry is a different attempt.

QuorumPeer.java:1180-1191 catches only FileNotFoundException for absent acceptedEpoch and substitutes epochOfZxid. Other startup I/O errors prevent the server from reaching handshake. The prior six-fault pilot applied faults but found zero same-occurrence/time-respecting postfault target paths.

decision: Preserve both as nonterminal fault-model/workload gaps. A future admission needs a different source-backed fault or existing cluster selector, a fresh named healthy path, then an exact affected-actor postfault target in a bounded pilot before any full budget.
